items.title: J. Leo Rayhill interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 23, 2007

ctx.x: First can I ask who was at the concert in the forties at Hamilton here. That was Eddie Condon with—
James P. Johnson was there, he was a wonderful piano player. Tony Parenti was there. Miff Mole, the old time trombone player from the twenties?
